perspectives: Both physical seats independently in every completed tape. Both estimators receive the same seat-visible carbon, both teams' public assets, step, and actual own issued moves if required by the tracker. No future or hidden information enters either estimator.
pilot: Use 345 old seat1 tape, steps 0..47. If actual encoded inputs and estimated rankings never differ and hidden map discrepancy is negligible, stop. No weight training or interaction.
metrics: Same-cell absolute error vs simulator truth: raw and actual deployed map values, split by physical terrain, stage, direct visibility, Sapling observed history, original known flag and candidate work radius. Ranking among local legal worker destinations and separately economically actionable cells. Count informative comparisons with distinct terrain values, rank reversals, ties, top truth optima, estimated-policy disagreements and estimated argmax truth regret with uniform tie handling. Collector uses target cell, planter uses four-neighbor mean. No forced causal winner credit.
